mapper.select: SELECT f_create_seq() AS resrch_id , #{empId} AS reg_person_id , f_emp_kor_nm(c.emp00_person_id)||' ('||c.emp00_org_kor_nm||')' AS reg_emp_name , f_trunc(f_sysdate())::date AS reg_date , f_trunc(f_sysdate())::date AS resrch_start_date , f_add_day(f_trunc(f_sysdate()), 7)::date AS resrch_close_date , f_apr_get_approval(#{empId}, f_trunc(f_sysdate()), apr06_appr_line01) AS cfrm_person_id , f_emp_kor_nm(a.emp00_person_id)||' ('||a.emp00_org_kor_nm||')' AS cfrm_emp_name , '10' AS target_type_code , '종목' AS target_type_name FROM apr06_appr_step_rule , emp00_trans_info a /* 승인자정보 */ , emp00_trans_info c /* 등록자정보 */ WHERE apr06_appr_step_rule_cd = 40 AND a.emp00_person_id = f_apr_get_approval(#{empId}, f_trunc(f_sysdate()), apr06_appr_line01) AND a.emp00_org_code_id = #{orgId} AND f_trunc(f_sysdate()) BETWEEN a.emp00_trans_date AND COALESCE(a.emp00_close_date, to_date('29991231','yyyyMMdd')) AND c.emp00_person_id = #{empId} AND f_trunc(f_sysdate()) BETWEEN c.emp00_trans_date AND COALESCE(c.emp00_close_date, to_date('29991231','yyyyMMdd'))

SELECT a.pln03_resrch_id AS resrch_id , a.pln03_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , b.dcr01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name , a.pln03_issuing_entity_id AS issuing_entity_id , CASE WHEN pln03_target_type_code = '10' THEN ( SELECT fnd07_issuing_entity_nm FROM fnd07_issuing_entity WHERE fnd07_issuing_entity_id = pln03_issuing_entity_id ) WHEN pln03_target_type_code = '20' THEN ( SELECT sys09_name FROM sys09_code WHERE sys09_code_id = pln03_issuing_entity_id ) ELSE NULL END AS issuing_entity_name , a.pln03_visit_reason AS visit_reason , a.pln03_reg_emp_id AS reg_person_id , f_emp_kor_nm(f.emp00_person_id)||' ('||f.emp00_org_kor_nm||')' AS reg_emp_name , a.pln03_reg_date::date AS reg_date , a.pln03_close_date::date AS close_date , a.pln03_close_yn AS close_yn , a.pln03_resrch_start_date::date AS resrch_start_date , a.pln03_resrch_close_date::date AS resrch_close_date , a.pln03_cfrm_emp_id AS cfrm_person_id , f_emp_kor_nm(e.emp00_person_id)||' ('||e.emp00_org_kor_nm||')' AS cfrm_emp_name , a.pln03_cfrm_date::date AS cfrm_date , a.pln03_note AS note , a.pln03_target_type_code AS target_type_code , f_cdnm('ResrchTargetTypeCode', a.pln03_target_type_code, f.emp00_company_id, pln03_reg_date) AS target_type_name FROM pln03_resrch a , dcr01_class_tree b , emp00_trans_info e , emp00_trans_info f WHERE a.pln03_class_tree_id = b.dcr01_class_tree_id AND a.pln03_cfrm_emp_id = e.emp00_person_id AND e.emp00_all_title = 0 AND a.pln03_reg_emp_id = f.emp00_person_id AND f.emp00_all_title = 0 AND a.pln03_reg_date BETWEEN e.emp00_trans_date AND COALESCE(e.emp00_close_date, to_date('29991231','yyyyMMdd')) AND a.pln03_reg_date BETWEEN f.emp00_trans_date AND COALESCE(f.emp00_close_date, to_date('29991231','yyyyMMdd')) AND a.pln03_resrch_id = #{resrchId}
SELECT count(*) FROM pln03_resrch WHERE pln03_resrch_id = #{resrchId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pln03_resrch ( pln03_resrch_id, pln03_class_tree_id, pln03_issuing_entity_id, pln03_visit_reason, pln03_reg_emp_id, pln03_reg_date , pln03_resrch_start_date, pln03_resrch_close_date, pln03_cfrm_emp_id, pln03_note, pln03_target_type_code ) VALUES( #{req.resrchId}, #{req.classTreeId}, #{req.issuingEntityId}, #{req.visitReason}, #{regPersonId}, f_trunc(f_sysdate()) , #{req.resrchStartDate}, #{req.resrchCloseDate}, #{req.cfrmPersonId}, #{req.note}, #{req.targetTypeCode} )
